statusDetail: Atomic audit completed. The origin returned HTTP 200 with a zero-byte body, so the only representative public route is a blank synthesized document.

page.notes: The origin returns Content-Type application/octet-stream and Content-Length 0. Chrome synthesizes empty html/head/body. No internal routes or archetypes were discoverable; robots.txt exists but sitemap.xml is invalid/empty.

paths.description: Homepage and only discoverable archetype. Audited as the public entry route under desktop, 360x800 mobile, dark, higher-contrast, reduced-motion, JavaScript-enabled, and crawler/no-JavaScript conditions. No other routes, links, forms, manifest shortcuts, or valid sitemap URLs were exposed, so no additional template could be selected.

findings.summary: The page does not adapt to dark color preference
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot remains a white blank surface; DOM evidence contains no color-scheme declaration or CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a real document and declare color-scheme, then theme surfaces with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: No navigation or meaningful attention path exists
findings.evidence: The rendered document has no text, links, headings, landmarks, or controls, so users cannot orient or proceed.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the intended content with a clear heading, navigation, and visually dominant primary action.

findings.summary: Content has been reduced to nothing
findings.evidence: Both browser and crawler captures are wholly blank; the server sends zero body bytes. This is not content-first minimalism because no content survives.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the core content and keep chrome subordinate to it.

findings.summary: The document omits the mobile viewport contract
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 emulation, layout reports hasViewportMeta=false and a 980 CSS-pixel layout viewport scaled to 0.367.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> and verify responsive layout with real content.

findings.summary: The page has no perceivable purpose or primary action
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 returns Content-Length: 0; rendered DOM body is empty and the screenshot is blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a meaningful document with a descriptive H1, concise purpose statement, and clear next action.

findings.summary: No primary journey can begin or complete
findings.evidence: The DOM has zero links, controls, and forms, leaving no user flow to exercise.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the site entry experience and provide a working path to its primary task.

findings.summary: The blank response offers no status or recovery
findings.evidence: The server returns a successful 200 with an empty body rather than explaining unavailable content or offering retry/navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return the intended content, or use an honest error status and humane recovery page with retry and support/navigation options.

findings.summary: The page never paints content
findings.evidence: The trace records no FCP and no LCP; Lighthouse aborts with NO_FCP. A fast blank response is not successful rendering.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore renderable HTML and then measure LCP, CLS, and INP on the meaningful page.

findings.summary: No semantic content or accessible interface is exposed
findings.evidence: Rendered HTML is only empty html/head/body; there are no headings, landmarks, links, controls, names, roles, or labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic HTML for restored content and ensure each interactive control has an accessible name and role.

findings.summary: The document has no landmarks, headings, or focus path
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows zero body children; keyboard and assistive-technology users receive no structure to navigate.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a logical heading hierarchy and landmark structure with a usable keyboard focus order.

findings.summary: There is no text to read
findings.evidence: Rendered and raw text character counts are both zero, confirmed by blank screenshots.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore readable content with a comfortable base font size, line length, spacing, and responsive typography.

findings.summary: Mobile and zoom readiness cannot meet the baseline without viewport metadata
findings.evidence: The mobile probe reports no viewport meta and a default 980 CSS-pixel viewport; no targets or media exist to offer a comparable experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Add the standard responsive viewport declaration, preserve zoom, and test restored targets/content at 200% and 400%.

findings.summary: The response is not a sound HTML document
findings.evidence: The origin serves Content-Type: application/octet-stream with Content-Length: 0; browser synthesizes empty html/head/body with no doctype or charset metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve non-empty semantic HTML as text/html; charset=utf-8 with a valid doctype and required head metadata.

findings.summary: The main resource uses the wrong media type
findings.evidence: Raw headers identify the public document as application/octet-stream rather than text/html, preventing a trustworthy authored-document contract.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure the origin/CDN to serve the HTML document with text/html; charset=utf-8 and verify status/media type in production.

findings.summary: Search and browser surfaces have no title or description
findings.evidence: Discoverability and DOM evidence show an empty title and no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique descriptive <title> and useful meta description to the restored HTML.

findings.summary: Crawlers and mobile users receive no content
findings.evidence: The raw response is zero bytes, renderedEmpty=true, and there is no viewport meta or crawlable link.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core content and crawlable href links, and add the responsive viewport meta tag.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: There is no canonical link; /sitemap.xml returns an 8-byte non-sitemap response, while the empty page still returns 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a canonical URL, publish a valid XML sitemap where appropriate, and return accurate HTTP status codes.

findings.summary: No structured or social metadata is present
findings.evidence: The empty head has no JSON-LD, Open Graph, or social preview metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate JSON-LD for applicable content plus Open Graph/social metadata after restoring the page.

findings.summary: Transport protection is underconfigured
findings.evidence: HTTPS and nosniff are present, but HSTS is max-age=1 and CSP is absent; raw headers also omit Referrer-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS with a durable max-age after validation, add a restrictive CSP, and set a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are missing
findings.evidence: Raw headers contain no CSP/frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy, or Referrer-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP including frame-ancestors, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and strict Referrer-Policy; use report-only rollout for CSP if needed.

findings.summary: No core content exists at the network or DOM layer
findings.evidence: The server HTML is zero bytes and both JS-enabled and no-JS screenshots are blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the core page content in HTML first, then enhance optional interactions with JavaScript.

findings.summary: The origin masks a failed experience as HTTP 200
findings.evidence: The main document is empty but responds 200, with no error, retry, stale content, or recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return the intended page or an accurate 4xx/5xx status with a resilient, actionable recovery document.

findings.summary: The document language is undeclared
findings.evidence: DOM evidence reports lang=null and dir is absent, leaving pronunciation and bidi defaults unspecified.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a valid lang on <html>, add dir when needed, and use logical CSS properties in restored styles.

findings.summary: The outage-like blank state is silent
findings.evidence: A user sees a blank screen with no explanation, progress, retry, contact route, or navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace silent failure with an honest message and specific recovery actions while fixing the empty origin response.

taskList.title: Restore a valid, non-empty semantic HTML document and core journey
Fix document media type, head metadata, language, viewport, canonical, and discovery metadata
Deploy durable transport and defensive browser policies
Add preference-aware theming after restoring the UI
Re-run CWV and accessibility testing against meaningful content
